♦️ **KUA PUTA TE FLEX GUI PRO V9.3.0! (AFTER EFFECTS)**

**MAP RIGS 2.0**, ko AutoCaptions me **Your script** me **Gemini 3.5 Transcribe**, me **Flex Studio (Beta)** ka tikiake i te tuatahi, ka pātai i mua i te tāuta.

*(Tāutahia ki runga i tō putanga o nāianei, kātahi ka tīmata anō i After Effects kia kotahi.)*

♦️ **Hou: MAP RIGS 2.0**
* Te whakatakotoranga **Map desk**, te rapu wāhi kāore he ipurangi, **Quick looks** (Country Pop, Space Dive, Trip Route me ētahi atu), Stick to Map, Clean labels, Always Sharp, ngā kāhua mahere koreutu me **Open in Flex Maps**.
* Ko ōna utauta tāpiri (tukutahi ora, kāhua, tapanga, 3D, Finalize) kua tino uta ki roto o After Effects ināianei.

♦️ **He mea hou kei AutoCaptions**
* Ko **Gemini 3.5 Transcribe** (kapua, ka whakamahi i ngā whiwhinga Flex AI) te pūkaha e tūtohua ana, kua kōwhiria kotahi te wā mō te katoa. Kōwhiria anō a Whisper hei hanga kupu hauraro koreutu ki tō rorohiko (me whai Whisper a Translate To). Mēnā he pukumahi te tūmau, ka kitea tō tūranga i te rārangi.
* **Your script**: ka mau ngā kupu hauraro i te tātaki me ngā kupu o tō hōtuhi ki ngā wāhi katoa i kōrero ai koe i aua kupu.
* Putanga **Editable template**: ko ngā kupu hauraro hei paparanga tauira, ā, ka taea e koe te whakahou te kāhua i Essential Properties (After Effects 2026).
* Kāore he mea kua tīpakohia, ā, kei te piako a Source media? Ka tukuna mai te **hanganga katoa**. Ka whakamahi anō te ororongo ōrite i tōna tuhinga.

♦️ **Flex Studio (Beta)**
* Ka tikiake a **Download Flex Studio (Beta)**, kātahi ka pātai **Install / Not now**.
* Te taupānga (2.0.0-beta.2): ngā mokowā mahi **PRO, TRACK, ROTOSCOPE, COLOR GRADING**, ngā pātuhi utauta o After Effects, ka tuwhera tonu ngā topenga, ā, ka mahi a OPEN ki ngā precomp me ngā paparanga whakatika.

♦️ **Kua whakatikaina**
* Kua hoki mai ngā pānga kaupapa i ngaro i te maha o ngā PC Windows (he māmā ake ina whakawetohia ngā pānga whakakorikori o Windows).

♦️ **Tauwāhi kōwhiringa mō te tiaki raihana**
* Kotahi anake te pātai, ā, he kōwhiringa: mā **No thanks** ka mahi tonu ngā mea katoa. Panonihia i **Flex Settings > Privacy**. Ka puritia mō ngā marama 12, kāore rawa e hokona, kāore rawa e tohaina, engari anake ina herea e te ture.

ult.message:
♦️ **KUA PUTA TE FLEX ULTIMATE V2.3.0! (PREMIERE PRO)**

**Kua nuku a Caption Stack ki roto o AutoCaptions** me ngā kāhua, ngā whakatakotoranga, te nekehanga me ngā oro mō ia kupu. Ka mahi a **UN-NEST** me ngā aratau whakaranu i Premiere 26.5, kotahi pēhi noa a **AUTO CUT**, ā, ka huakina e **Flex Studio (Beta)** tō topenga mai i te paewhiri.

*(Tāutahia ki runga i tō putanga o nāianei, kātahi ka tīmata anō i Premiere Pro kia kotahi.)*

♦️ **Hou: Ngā kupu hauraro korikori kei AutoCaptions**
* **Kāhua kupu**: hoatu ki tētahi kupu ōna ake tae, momotuhi me te otinga Flat, Shine, Glow rānei.
* **Ngā whakatakotoranga rārangi**: Stack, Over, Under, Beside me Line.
* **Nekehanga mō ia kupu** (Fade, Pop, Rise, Type, Shake me ētahi atu) me te arokite, tae atu ki ngā oro **Pop / Tick / Swoosh**. Me whai ngā kāhua kupu me te nekehanga i te putanga **Images**.
* Ko **Gemini 3.5 Transcribe** (kapua, ka whakamahi i ngā whiwhinga Flex AI) te pūkaha e tūtohua ana ināianei, kua kōwhiria kotahi te wā mō te katoa; kōwhiria he pūkaha Whisper hei hanga kupu hauraro koreutu, kāore he ipurangi.
* **Your script** (aratau Captions): ka mau ngā kupu hauraro i ngā kupu o tō hōtuhi ki ngā wāhi i kōrero ai koe i aua kupu.
* Ki te kore he mea i tīpakohia (kei te piako te kāri Source), ka tukuna mai te **rārangi wā katoa**; ka tiakina ngā kupu hauraro ki te taha o tō kaupapa.

♦️ **Hou: Flex Studio (Beta)**
* Ka aroturuki a **Open in Flex Studio** i te topenga i te taupānga; ka whakahoki a **APPLY TO PREMIERE** i te aroturuki. Kāore anō kia tāutatia? Ka tikiake a **Download Flex Studio (Beta)**, kātahi ka pātai **Install / Not now**.

♦️ **Kua panonitia**
* Ka tātari a **AUTO CUT** i tētahi topenga kua tīpakohia, ka tapahi i te pēhi kotahi. Ka hopu a **Retakes** i ngā rārangi i tīmata anō.
* E ono ngā ripa-iti o **Audio Studio** ināianei. Kei Nest Saver te **Library** ināianei.

♦️ **Kua whakatikaina**
* **UN-NEST** i Premiere 26.5 (i whakakāhoretia ia nest), me ngā aratau whakaranu pērā i a Screen i hoki ki Normal (Premiere i te reo Ingarihi).
* Te tohu whero **AUTOSAVE 0:00**, te arokite pango o Caption Stack, me ngā pānga kaupapa i ngaro i te maha o ngā PC Windows.

♦️ **Tauwāhi kōwhiringa mō te tiaki raihana**
* Kotahi anake te pātai, ā, he kōwhiringa: mā **No thanks** ka mahi tonu ngā mea katoa. Panonihia i **Flex Settings > Privacy**. Ka puritia mō ngā marama 12, kāore rawa e hokona, kāore rawa e tohaina, engari anake ina herea e te ture.
